name: Abelian Sandpile
desc: The Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld abelian sandpile grows grain by grain from a fixed central pour into its iconic self-similar mandala of nested squares and diamonds, exact integer heights 0-3 rendered through a hard four-colour LUT so every crisp fractal boundary reads razor-sharp across indigo-blue-gold-white spectral, blackbody thermal, copper-oxide patina, clean grayscale, and glowing neon-edge looks.

scale.doc: cell coarseness / grid resolution (higher = chunkier blocks, fewer columns)

energy.doc: exposure / brightness of the height ramp

density.doc: pour rate (grains per frame -> growth speed & avalanche activity)

hue.doc: base palette hue (rotates the whole height ramp)

x.doc: pour source center x (the mandalas origin)

style.doc: render philosophy: spectral indigo->blue->gold->white ordered ramp / thermal blackbody by height / copper-oxide patina greens+rust / grayscale four clean greys (mono) / neon-edge only the height boundaries glow as lines (abstract)

seed.doc: deterministic variation (seed>0 adds 4-fold-symmetric secondary pour sources)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg; lower = translucent)
